show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: James Aitken – Macro Strategist Extraordinaire (Capital Allocators, EP.58)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

key_points.text: You can keep up to date by visiting Capital Allocatorspodcast.com.
key_points.evidence_quote: You can keep up to date by visiting Capital Allocatorspodcast.com.

key_points.text: My guest on today's show is Australian-born James Aitken, the founder and managing partner of Aitken Advisors, a one-man macroeconomic consultancy based in Wimbledon.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest on today's show is Australian-born James Aitken, the founder and managing partner of Aitken Advisors, a one-man macroeconomic consultancy based in Wimbledon, England, that works with approximately 100 of the most influential pools of capital in the world.

key_points.text: James started his career in 1992 as a foreign exchange trader, moved to London in May of 1999.
key_points.evidence_quote: James started his career in 1992 as a foreign exchange trader, moved to London in May of 1999, and in March 2002 joined the infamous AIG Financial Products team in London.

key_points.text: In August of 2006, two years before the crisis hit, he joined UB.S.
key_points.evidence_quote: In August of 2006, two years before the crisis hit, he joined UB.S.

thesis: The speaker argues that he initially knew nothing about the critical factors of the financial system despite believing he was well-read, a realization sparked by conversations with senior colleagues at AIG. He further contends that it is difficult for individuals to understand complex financial risks when their compensation depends on them remaining ignorant of those risks.
